1. Initialize register 0 with value 0
2. Use a loop to increment register 0 and try each value (0-16383) as the key
3. For each value, execute ENT to try to enter enclave mode
4. Check register 3 to see if we successfully entered (regfile[3] == 0)
5. Once we enter enclave mode, use MOVFS to read the flag from safe_rom
6. Store the flag in RAM at addresses starting from 255 going down
"""

# Instruction encoding
ENT = 7     # Enter protected mode
INC = 12    # Increment register
MOVFS = 13  # Move from safe ROM to register (needs emode=1)
MOVT = 6    # Move from register to RAM
JEQ = 10    # Jump if equal
JMP = 11    # Unconditional jump

# Register numbers

R1 = 1
R3 = 3

LOOP_ADDR = 0      # Address of the brute force loop
FOUND_ADDR = 10    # Address when key is found
END_ADDR = 128     # End of program

# Create the program

# Loop to try keys (addresses 0-9)
# ENT instruction (try reg0 as key)
program.append(ENT)
# Check if we succeeded (JEQ r3, r0, FOUND_ADDR)
program.append((R3 << 4) | (R0 << 6) | JEQ)
program.append(FOUND_ADDR)
# Increment r0
program.append((R0 << 4) | INC)
# Jump back to start of loop (JMP LOOP_ADDR)
program.append(JMP)
program.append(LOOP_ADDR)
# Padding to reach FOUND_ADDR

    program.append((R3 << 4) | MOVT)

1. Initialize register 0 with value 0

MOVFS = 13  # Move from safe ROM to register (needs emode=1)
MOVT = 6    # Move from register to RAM

JMP = 11    # Unconditional jump

R3 = 3

# Address 2: Jump target (10)

# Address 3: INC r0 (increment reg0)

# Address 4: JMP 0 (jump back to loop start)
